messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate observed for /v1/generate (5xx + timeouts). 5m error rate 47% -> paging oncall. source: envoy_frontend cluster 'lb-edge', spike started ~03:22 UTC :fire:

alex: saw it in graphs, pushing to #incidents. oncall?

sanjay: I'm oncall, joining — pinging eng-runtime and eng-sre. starting initial triage. :eyes:

maria: I can look at routing and LB config. pulling recent deploys.

ingrid: I grabbed traces, looks like Envoy returning 503 from upstream-selection. also seeing retry storms in proxy logs.

alex: can someone grep envoy logs for "upstream reset" and "x-envoy-upstream-service-time"?

maria: running now. snippet:```bash
kubectl -n prod logs svc/lb-edge -c envoy | grep "upstream reset" | tail -n 50
```

maria: logs show lots of `upstream reset` followed by `503` and `x-envoy-retry` headers. pattern started after 03:19 UTC.

tim: FYI I pushed a route tweak earlier (deploy 2190000999) to adjust route weights for canary. commit: `a1b2c3d tweak: route weight 0.25 -> 0.5 for model-backend`

deploy-bot: Deploy 2190000999 succeeded: canary route update applied to lb-edge (RDS).

ingrid: possible root cause: retry policy + misweighted route forced more traffic to a smaller cluster shard, causing 503s, which then retried by Envoy -> cascaded 5xx. 

alex: can we temporarily disable retries on frontend route for /v1/generate to stop the retry amplification?

maria: we can patch the Envoy route config via RDS: set `retry_policy: None` or set `max_retry_attempts: 0`. doing a dry-run first.

maria: patch applied:```yaml
route:
  match: /v1/generate
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: ""
    num_retries: 0
```

deploy-bot: RDS patch applied to lb-edge: route /v1/generate update (no retries).

ingrid: monitoring... 5m error rate dropped from 47% -> 22% in first minute. latency also dropping.

alex: good. still seeing elevated 5xx from model-backend cluster. need to scale or adjust circuit breakers. current cb config seems low: `max_pending_requests: 50` and `max_requests: 200` per host.

sanjay: check cluster stats:```text
cluster.model-backend: cx_active 60, rq_pending_active 120, rq_timeout 35
```

maria: increasing circuit breaker thresholds for model-backend cluster to avoid early tripping while we scale. applying cluster patch:```yaml
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - priority: DEFAULT
      max_connections: 1000
      max_pending_requests: 500
      max_requests: 1000
```

deploy-bot: Cluster patch applied to lb-edge: model-backend CB updated.

ingrid: after CB increase and retries disabled, 5xx dropped to 6% over 5m. we'll keep an eye.

cs-jen: CS: we're seeing a surge of support tickets from power customers — about 12 orgs show >20% error rates over last 10m. notifying account owners.

alex: good catch. can we get a short impact summary for SRE/CS handoff? include timeframe, top endpoints, percent error, mitigations applied, and rollback plan.

maria: Draft impact summary: "03:19–03:40 UTC elevated 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate caused by misweighted route + aggressive retries leading to upstream overload. Mitigation: disabled retries at frontend (03:25 UTC), increased cluster CB thresholds (03:28 UTC). Result: 5xx reduced from ~47% to ~6% by 03:33 UTC. Root change: deploy 2190000999 adjusted route weight for model-backend. Next steps: roll forward with more gradual weight shifts, add automated canary guard for error spike >5%, revert if rollback required."

cs-jen: sending to affected customers and coordinating refunds where appropriate. please also add a public incident note if we see sustained customer-visible errors.

sanjay: scheduling a postmortem. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, eng-platform. add follow-ups: tighten retry defaults (no retries on edge), add cluster autoscale policy for model-backend, and alert rule for retry amplification (error + retry rate correlation).

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: when 5xx spike + retry headers present -> disable frontend retries, scale upstream pool, increase CB thresholds, then roll weights back slowly.

tim: will open PR to change default route retry_policy to disabled and add an automated canary check for route weight changes.

alex: oncall handoff: Sanjay -> Ingrid in 20m for stabilization follow-up. Ingrid you ok to take next hour?

ingrid: taking the handoff. monitoring dashboards pinned to #incidents. leaving short note in pager duty.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and marked: mitigated. Severity: S2 (customer impact, degraded for ~14m).

sanjay: thanks team. postmortem owners: tim (config), maria (runtime), ingrid (monitoring).

cs-jen: will follow up with customers and post a status update. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing thread for live mitigation. keep comments in this thread for any new regressions.
